title: Construct exact contraction and obstruction certificates for coupled recurrences
body:
Coupled types can fail even when each local change passes a separate test. Add an exact producer/checker for a nonnegative rational matrix: either construct positive weights proving strict contraction and the total sum of forced iterates, or construct a nonzero nonnegative subeigenvector ruling out strict contraction of that matrix. No floating eigenvalue calculation is used.

The guide proves the elimination alternatives and distinguishes coefficient upper bounds from lower bounds. It includes a pinned normalization of the existing least-barrier source fixture. The tool reproduces (49/156,10/39,83/234); the existing unsafe two-coefficient update gives witness (9/4,1,0). Credit Nick Petalas, the coupled-update work, David Ganz / Dugongue, Jose Manuel and their retained lineage. This implements the classical M-matrix alternative as a general bounded tool; no new theorem priority is claimed.

Six tests pass normally and under -O on CPython 3.12.14: all 256 matrices on a two-type rational grid, exact source examples, singular/reducible cases, the 64-type bound, a 10^-12 contraction margin, forged certificates and isolated input-hash replay. The independent checker does no elimination.

Limits: 64 types, nonnegative coefficient numerators/denominators at most 10^12. Rational growth affects runtime. A noncontracting upper bound does not disprove the actual caller; zero or unreachable forcing can miss a bad component. Source recurrence coverage, native costs and all-size compiler assumptions remain open. No kappa or frontier change. Fresh upstream/overlap checked. Canonical scope https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5776. All 6 new tests pass in the [hosted plan](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40384218793/job/121788081921) at this head. The plan fails on the unchanged assignment module (8 failures and 2 errors); replay is skipped. The existing fix is [PR #5761](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5761). Independent review remains pending.

Base: `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`. Verified head: `c047cb85ff5957f09afdcad3a8b16b637fbb5380`.

Prepared for Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Retained tool and mathematical predecessor credits apply. No selected-frontier change.

Exact certificate rationals have a 6000-bit numerator/denominator budget. Larger outputs fail before serialization and emit no partial certificate.
